field-multiline.$description: Multi-line text boxes (textareas). Terminal stays square.

pill.$description: Fully-round controls (tags, chips, segmented pickers, meters). Terminal stays square.

badge.$description: Status dots and notification badges. Round in every style, Terminal included.

status.$description: Agent status marks (needs you, monitoring, no update, live, the working grid's cells). Terminal keeps them square.

surface.$description: 45-degree corner cut on cards, tiles and popovers. Panes stay square. 0px is a plain corner.

switch-sm-width.$description: Compact switch track width, for dense rows.

search-height.$description: Search field height (scaled with density). Taller than a form field, like the phone's search pill.

tile.$description: Mosaic tile margin — Terminal's historical value; adjacent tiles show a 2px seam filled by the divider.

section.$description: Between stacked sections within a region.

window.$description: Padding between the window edge and the app shell — >0 makes the whole UI float on bg-canvas.

width.$description: Mosaic split bar width (also the drag hit-area). Terminal's historical value. Keep = 2 × gap.tile so the bar fills the seam.

color.$description: Split bar fill. Gap presets set this transparent so floating tiles have invisible-but-draggable seams (hover still shows accent).

surface.$description: Multi-layer shadow ring around panes/cards. Terminal uses real 1px borders instead. NOTE: 0 0 #0000 (no-op), never the keyword none — ring and shadow slots compose into one box-shadow list in the <Surface> primitive.

edge.$description: Frost surface edge line. Off until the new Glass supplies a value.

sheen.$description: Frost surface top highlight. A shadow slot: 0 0 #0000 is off, never the keyword none.
Inset highlight. 0 0 #0000 is off, never the keyword none.

shadow.$description: Tile drop shadow. 0 0 #0000 is off, never the keyword none.

scale.$description: Multiplier on control heights/padding. Terminal is compact = 1.

press-scale.$description: Transform scale while a control is pressed. 1 is no movement.

code.$description: Code and fixed-width data. Emits --font-code: --font-mono is Tailwind v4's own variable, read by every font-mono utility.

micro.$description: Type scale. The group is type, not text: Tailwind v4 owns --text-*, and overriding --text-xs would resize every text-xs utility.
